title: Total degree of a nonzero polynomial product
statement: Let $D$ be a commutative integral domain, meaning a nonzero commutative ring without zero divisors, and let $I$ be any set. For a polynomial $h\in D[x_i:i\in I]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], define $\operatorname{tdeg}(h)$ as the maximum of the sums of exponents of the monomials with nonzero coefficient, with $\operatorname{tdeg}(0)=0$. For nonzero polynomials $f,g$ one has $\operatorname{tdeg}(fg)=\operatorname{tdeg}(f)+\operatorname{tdeg}(g)$.
